description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing a weather forecast service that provides a travel guide for a specified city. It includes endpoint definitions, geocoding via OpenStreetMap Nominatim, fetching weather data from Open-Meteo, and generating clothing recommendations and mocked points of interest.

classes.name: DailyForecast
classes.description: Represents a single day's weather forecast with temperature, precipitation probability, and condition.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Provides clothing tips based on forecast data.

classes.name: PopularPlace
classes.description: Details about a popular place to visit.

classes.name: TravelGuideResponse
classes.description: Response model aggregating forecast, recommendations, and places for a city.

methods.name: TravelGuideResponse get_travel_guide(city: str = Query(..., description="City name to search, e.g., 'Paris' or 'New York'"))
methods.description: Main endpoint to generate a travel guide for a specified city, including geocoding, forecast, recommendations, and mocked places.

methods.name: _geocode_city(city: str)
methods.description: Performs geocoding of city name using Nominatim to get coordinates and formatted names.

methods.name: List[DailyForecast] _fetch_5day_forecast(lat: float, lon: float)
methods.description: Fetches a 5-day weather forecast from Open-Meteo API for given coordinates.
